findings.impact: Plane/decoupling quality defect: B.Cu runs over the island or finger reference copper joined to the main 3V3 plane through one 0.3 mm trace or the buck output node; buzzer pulses and U1 pin-11 decoupling share that island (part of the current may pass through U1, Inference); slow nets ride unreferenced along 75 mm of In2 slots. No functional, timing or safety failure is demonstrated; fast-net K-region continuity still holds.
findings.concrete_fix: Re-plan In2 so no rail is cut: (a) take the USB_LIMITED south leg off the 3V3 interior - run it in the existing 3V3/CH1-GND boundary gap (y~51.3) or on an outer layer, and feed R87.1 (22.0,63.1) from the C98/U11.7 side instead of the In2 branch (26.2,61.8)-(22.45,61.8)-(22.0,62.25) that severs the finger; (b) move the 3V3A trunk off the y=50.2 strip under U1; (c) refill and require one 3V3 In2 piece. Gate (records/checks only, allowed under D-R16-03): report every In2 rail fill piece with its plane-copper bridge width and make K-region piece-aware. Requalify K-reference/K-region and the C98/USB startup records after any change.
